title: Single cell RNAseq to identify subpopulations of glial progenitors in iPSC-derived oligodendroglial lineage cultures.
abstract: Cellular heterogeneity is a common issue in differentiation protocols of oligodendrocytes (OLs) from human induced pluripotent stem cells. Our previous work described a novel method to generate OLs and highlighted the presence of glial progenitors. Here, we unravel the glial heterogeneity and characterize the response of isolated subpopulations to differentiation. This study provides a novel tool for studying the dynamics of glial development in vitro and on a transcriptomic level.
